criteria.basis: Reviewed manifest validation, selected candidate review, task completion and criteria handling. Creation accepted=false remains immutable and separate from current eligibility.

Default is the current nominee, not the newest package. No nominee returns no selected package. Explicit historical selection preserves saved member order and reports current nomination/review and stale reasons.

Retained candidate record identity, source URI, member SHA-256, size and package path are validated before projecting name/kind/opaque metadata. F/C/I/S declarations carry current and saved identity labels; package stale reasons include changed semantic bindings.

Absent metadata remains not_declared and present metadata remains not_interpreted. The contract expressly requires caller-needed slicing/timing/pivot facts to come from declarations or cited consumer source, not filename/kind/size guesses.

Direct member-contract and destination-choice S references expose exact local bytes and resolved retained revisions. Remote sources are explicitly unavailable and block eligibility without a fetch; independently exercised in review-probes-01.json.

Read-path inspection confirms producer state must remain under root, graph.confined checks local sources, and delivery._manifest rejects redirected manifest/member locations and verifies retained bytes. Existing tests cover state escape and missing/corrupt retained assets. No new symlink execution was performed in this review.

Pending jobs and relevant current task PLAR selections add unresolved conditions independently of passing review. A valid completed synthetic family lost its live PLAR file and became ineligible without losing passing criteria or mutating files; independently exercised in review-probes-01.json.

CLI/MCP view and candidate additions retain the complete default path and result-export mechanism. Reviewed regression tests include default parity, cold process CLI/MCP parity, fresh export and no overwrite. Direct missing-root CLI probe returned the existing argparse required-root error for both views.

Projection supplies names, exact retained file identities, declared contracts/choices and source locators while spec requires actual index/manifest/assets/needed sources transfer. Static review does not establish actual cold integration or rendered behavior; that qualification remains separately owned.
